What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13955030/assets/e4018ea79601a725ad4586eda123eaa5900a171bbce505c4c58c3bf80af7e6a8.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-1,-3).$
